title: Compact direct images needed by the generic argument
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be a separated finite-type morphism between
finite-type schemes over a field of characteristic different from
$\ell$. For $K\in D^b_c(X,\mathbf F_\ell)$, its
compact direct image
$Rf_!K$ is bounded constructible. For every morphism $v:S'\to S$ with Noetherian $S'$,
the compact direct-image exchange
$v^*Rf_!K\to Rf'_!v_X^*K$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Convert the project bounded-constructibility predicate into the source predicate using the finite-value/finite-stalk constructibility equivalence on every cohomology sheaf. DerivedCategory.isGE_iff and isLE_iff identify interval vanishing with t-structure boundedness. In the reverse direction use [min a b,max a b], so no ordering of an arbitrary pair of t-structure bounds is required.

source.place: compactification, extension-by-zero, proper-direct-image and exchange paragraphs

proof.text: Use the supplied compactification c; no application of Nagata is necessary. The proper map c.g has locally finite-type composite with aS, and its source is quasi-compact over the quasi-compact S. Thus c.Z is Noetherian and the open immersion c.i is quasi-compact. Apply boundedConstructible_mapDerivedCategory_openImmersionLowerShriek: exact extension by zero commutes with cohomology and preserves constructible sheaves. Convert its result back with the preceding equivalence.

source.place: compactification, extension-by-zero, proper-direct-image and exchange paragraphs

proof.text: The lifted prime field is finite, ℓ is positive, and its ℓ-cast is zero. The nonzero field element ℓ is a unit. Map this unit through the inverse of ΓSpecIso and the structure morphism on global sections to verify IsSmoothBaseChangeCoefficients on both S and c.Z. Apply isBoundedConstructible_rightDerivedLowerStar_of_proper to c.g with structure morphism c.g ≫ aS and the extension-by-zero complex. By the compact-support definition this is exactly the first conclusion.

source.place: compactification, extension-by-zero, proper-direct-image and exchange paragraphs

proof.text: For any stated square apply the already available instance isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap at K. It is precisely the specified map for c and c.ofIsPullback sq; this is the objectwise invertibility clause of finite-torsion compact-support base change. Its existing proof is the proper-exchange/extension-by-zero composite, so no coefficient-forgetting comparison or new base-change compactification construction is needed here.
